name: Turkish Get Up
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell overhead in one hand with the knee on that side bent.
Roll onto your elbow, then your hand.
Bridge your hips and sweep your leg back into a half-kneeling position.
Stand up, keeping the weight overhead.
Reverse the steps to return to the floor.
longevityNotes: Single-leg strength and balance are what keep you steady on uneven ground and stairs. Lunge work trains the stability that prevents the falls that change lives.
overview: A multi-step movement from lying to standing with a weight overhead that trains stability and mobility.
